title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
starring: Jim Carrey, Kate Winslet, Kirsten Dunst, Mark Ruffalo, Elijah Wood, Tom Wilkinson
summary: After a painful breakup, Joel discovers that his former girlfriend Clementine has undergone a procedure to erase all memories of their relationship. Heartbroken, he decides to undergo the same treatment, but as his memories begin to disappear, he realises he doesn't want to forget the woman he once loved.
